context: A married couple plans a weekend road trip to family
purpose: Teach: 焼肉/百貨店/デッキ/蛙/水槽/ソフトウエア/小道具/浜松

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 週末さ、浜松のお義母さんのところ、車で行かない？
lines.en: Hey, how about driving to your mom's place in Hamamatsu this weekend?
lines.style: Casual wife floating a weekend road trip idea

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいね。じゃあ夜は駅前の焼肉でも家族で食べようか。
lines.en: Sounds good. Then let's all grab grilled meat near the station that night.
lines.style: Warm husband happily agreeing to the plan

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お土産は途中の百貨店で買っていけば間に合うかな。
lines.en: I think we can pick up gifts at the department store on the way.
lines.style: Practical wife planning gift stops along the route

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだな、あと健太のリクエストで水槽用のソフトウエアもインストールしてやるって約束したんだ。
lines.en: Right, and I promised Kenta I'd install some software for his fish tank too.
lines.style: Dad fondly remembering a promise to his son

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あの子、まだ蛙とか昆虫を捕まえて持ち帰るの好きよね。
lines.en: Our boy still loves catching frogs and bugs to bring home, doesn't he.
lines.style: Mom laughing warmly about their son's quirky hobbies

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ウッドデッキで一緒に虫かご作るって言ってたよ。小道具も持ってきてって。
lines.en: He said we'd build a bug cage together on the deck — and to bring the props too.
lines.style: Husband sharing what their son excitedly planned for them

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ金曜の夜出発で決まりね。私、明日のうちに荷物まとめておくわ。
lines.en: Then it's settled — we leave Friday night. I'll pack everything by tomorrow.
lines.style: Wife wrapping up the conversation with cheerful resolve
